test: docker compose run --rm app bundle exec rspec
test:e2e: docker compose run --rm app bundle exec rspec spec/e2e/*
test:models: docker compose run --rm app bundle exec rspec spec/models/*
migrate: docker compose run --rm app bin/rails db:migrate
db:prepare: docker compose run --rm app bin/rails db:prepare
console: docker compose run --rm app bin/rails console
